text: Co-organized the First Prague Workshop on Responsible AI at FEE CTU (130+ registrations).
Started an Applied Research Internship at Superhuman (formerly Grammarly).
Joined the EleutherAI Summer of Open AI Research (SOAR), working on sparse autoencoders.
Talk on communicating Responsible AI to different audiences at the CTU SciComm Meetup.
Teaching assistant for the new Machine Learning Methods course at FEE CTU (explainable AI, neurosymbolic AI, LLMs for structured data).
Presented Binarizing Physics-Inspired GNNs at ECAI 2025 and XAI Desiderata for Trustworthy AI at the European Workshop on Trustworthy AI held with ECAI, Bologna.
